notes.title: Log: 1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Update Log - Version 1.1.0.1  

Fixes and Balancing:  
- Adjusted and buffed our dear Augustus' damage—enjoy responsibly!  
- To balance things out, his cost has been slightly increased.  
- Fixed an issue where the Antiquity music wouldn’t stop when returning to the menu.  
- Fixed a bug that allowed placing characters in invalid locations if placed too quickly.  
- The sell and fusion buttons now stay on the same side, regardless of whether the card is on the left or right.  

New Additions:  
- You can now move the screen using the arrow keys!  
- Hovering over flying enemies now displays an indicator showing they can fly.  
- In Infinite Mode, new enemies will now appear gradually—every 10 waves, a new enemy joins the rotation!  

Defend well and enjoy the game! 🚀🔥

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.0 Arrived
notes.notes:
Changelog - Version 1.1.0.0

---

New Features:
- Cutscenes:
  -- All cutscenes have been redone, and several new ones added to enrich the game's narrative.  
- New Era: Late Antiquity:
  -- Added with 5 new maps and unique characters to explore:
    --- Merchant, Constantine I, Belisarius, Attila, Hypatia, and...  
- New Game Mechanic: Training:
  -- Now you can generate gems automatically, even AFK!
  -- Access it by sliding left on the game mode selection screen (available from level 4 of the Nomads).  
- Flying Enemy:
  -- A new enemy that can fly has been added! ☠️  
- New Music:
  -- Exclusive themes for the Roman and Greek eras.  
- Locked Game Modes:
  -- Some game modes now start locked and are unlocked as you progress in story mode.  
- Time Machine:
  -- The robots' machine now has an appropriate size, improved animations, and actually looks functional!  
- Card Visual Update:
  -- Card backgrounds have been redesigned for a more attractive look.  
- Initial Menu Screen:
  -- Multiple Saves: Manage multiple saves, test strategies, or restart whenever you want.
  -- Save Management: Option to load or delete saves directly from the menu.
  -- Improved Language Selection: You can now easily switch the game's language.
  -- Custom Translations: Add translations for new languages by simply inserting a file into the "languages" folder in the game's directory. Contributions for the official version can be made via the developer's Discord.

---

Fixes:

Bug Fixes:
- Card Selling Crash:
  -- Fixed a bug where the game would crash when selling a card with an active projectile.
- Simultaneous Shots:
  -- Fixed an error where one of the shots would not appear when two characters fired simultaneously.
- Dark Mode Switching:
  -- Fixed a minor visual error when switching between game modes.
- Enemy Position:
  -- Enemies now appear higher up compared to player-placed characters, improving gameplay.
- Fonts:
  -- Updated for better readability in dialogues and specific game areas.
- Inventory Zoom:
  -- Increased zoom on cards to make information easier to read.
- Upgrade Screen Freeze:
  -- Fixed an issue where the screen would freeze on the upgrade screen when advancing a wave.
- Cancel Button in Upgrade Screen:
  -- Fixed a bug where the cancel button was displayed in the top-right corner of the screen.  
- Double Clicks:
 -- Fixed a bug where double-clicking a button would transition to the next screen, disabling interactions.
- Selected Character:
  -- Now, after winning the game, the previously selected character no longer remains active.  

Balancing and Details:
- Tutorial Message:
  -- Added 3 extra waves before the initial tutorial message appears for better balance.
- Prehistoric Era Dialogues:
  -- Revised for alignment with the new cutscenes and better narrative coherence.
- Inventory:
  -- Character information texts were adjusted for better layout.  
- Endless Mode:
  -- Improved balance for a more consistent experience.
  -- Added the best wave display on the endless mode screen.
- Dialogue Frequency:
  -- Reduced how often character dialogues appear during gameplay.
- Main Menu Music:
  -- Updated with a new soundtrack.  

Buffs and Nerfs:
- Characters:
  -- Pedrador:
    --- Slightly buffed starting from the second fusion in the game.
  -- Braseiro:
    --- Fire duration doubled, and damage adjusted (now equivalent to Braseiro's damage divided by 5).
    --- Fire aesthetics updated.
  -- Porrada:
    --- Significantly increased attack speed.
    --- Price reduced to 50.
  -- Herod:
    --- Attack speed nerfed.
  -- John the Baptist:
    --- Range corrected.
  -- Alexander:
    --- Range corrected.
  -- Fixed Era Bosses:
    --- Nerfed bosses for levels 2, 3, 4, and 5 for better balance.

---

Get ready to explore new eras and face even more exciting challenges! 🎮

notes.title: Log Update
notes.notes:
What's New:

Added 27 Steam Achievements to explore!
Many more abbreviations for large numbers
Italian language added!
Legendary cards (Black) and the... are now locked for the inventory, preventing them from being used as EXP by mistake!


[b]Adjustments:[/b]

Bugs:

Clicking on the deck card would keep the information language in Portuguese.


Characters:

Some characters had different damage values in the inventory compared to the actual game.
Minor Nerf to Ervoso.
Tiny Nerf to Tutancamon.
Minor Nerf to Pythagoras.
Buff to John the Baptist; he now has more range and slows down enemies.
Buff to Alexander the Great’s speed.
Nerf to Augustus; he now provides 1/4 of the buff he used to.


Infinity:

Now, upon reaching wave 70 in infinite mode, you can spin 10 cards at once!
Upon reaching wave 50 in infinite mode, you can spin 6 cards at once! (Mathematically, this makes no difference compared to the 5 cards at wave 40, but it looks cooler!)

notes.title: "House Of Cards: TD" Now Available!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that [b]House Of Cards: TD[/b] is officially released! In a world where intelligent robots threaten to alter history, you must protect the past, present, and future. Travel through various eras, control historical figures, and defend against robotic foes in a unique tower defense game that combines strategy, character fusion, and luck.

Strategically position historical heroes and use fusion to strengthen your defenders. Unlock new characters, face challenging bosses, and explore a pixelated world full of adventures. Join us in this early access launch, contribute to the development, and get ready for many future updates!
